custom/discord_status.on-click: pgrep -x Discord > /dev/null && (hyprctl dispatch focusmonitor l && WS=$(hyprctl activeworkspace -j | jq -r '.name') && hyprctl dispatch focuswindow 'class:^(discord)$' && hyprctl dispatch movetoworkspace "$WS") || (hyprctl dispatch focusmonitor l && discord)
custom/discord_status.on-click-right: hyprctl dispatch sendshortcut CTRL_SHIFT, M, class:^[Dd]iscord$
